environment.description: Actix-web service deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'prod-api' with Istio sidecar injection enabled. The service logs are collected by a Fluentd DaemonSet and forwarded to Elasticsearch/Kibana SIEM. No input sanitization on log entries. The service is exposed via Istio IngressGateway with a VirtualService routing external traffic to the pod on port 8080. Istio mTLS is in PERMISSIVE mode. No AuthorizationPolicy resources are applied to the namespace.

config.ingress: istio-ingressgateway with VirtualService routing to service
